text:
lets work on the storyline builder a bit. its got a scuffed start and id like to make sure it lands correctly. As it stands right now, what i need you to do is remove all the missions another made, (there is just 1) and then we need to start with some basics here on this, first being a button for new to start with haha. 
Now, here is the hierarchy of how this will work

we start always 100% must pick a quest line. if there are no existing, we make one. so, give me a button for creating questlines. Questlines have the highest order because it keeps organization. even for one off quests, they can be put into misc/extra/random events. The current approach asks me to provide a string for the questline. this is wrong, the questline needs to be a created object

what is a questline
basic: 
- core array of missions
- summary
- requirements (this is a greater dependency, as missions inside of these will have their own)
- rewards (extra reward for finishing entire line)
resolution: Rebuilt the storyline builder to be questline-first per the user's ruling. The prior start was scuffed: it seeded the single Claude-placeholder mission and treated 'questline' as a bare string field on each quest. Now a questline is a created OBJECT (title, summary, requirements=the greater dependency, rewards=finish-the-line bonus, and the core array of missions). The builder starts EMPTY — createStoryStore() takes no seed; the substrate's ruled DELIVERY_GIG is untouched, only the builder stopped auto-seeding it. New Questline is the only move on a blank board (emptyActions); New Mission/Delete appear once a line is selected. Roster lists lines with nested missions; the panel dispatches questline-panel vs mission-panel; the board scopes to the selected line. Files: store.ts/panel.ts/source.tsx/StoryBoard.tsx (model.ts pure-derivation unchanged, tests stay green).
